postage._services_comment: Observed eBay service code -> { label, tier, tracked, note }. Checked FIRST, before every regex, so this is how the store's banded postage gets classified honestly. Codes read live off the account's three fulfilment policies 2026-08-14. Band 1 is the NORMAL band now, so it is tier 'standard' even though the buyer paid $1.70: a plain letter needs nothing different from the packer. Bands 2 and 3 are 'tracked' because someone has to go and buy a label. AU_Regular is the one that MUST be here — it matches none of the classifier's patterns, so without this entry an $8.26 tracked order falls through to 'paid', gets no upgrade banner, and is packed as a plain letter.
